breaking_news.headline: Paramount-Warner Brothers merger gets Justice Department approval
breaking_news.summary: The Justice Department closed its investigation into the proposed $110 billion merger of Paramount and Warner Brothers Discovery, saying it found no threat to competition or consumers.

breaking_news.headline: Kennedy Center removes Trump's name from the building
breaking_news.summary: Workers finished removing President Trump's name from the facade of the Kennedy Center early Saturday, hours after a court-ordered Friday deadline to remove references to Trump from the building.

breaking_news.headline: Oil prices drop to cheapest level since early days of Middle East conflict
breaking_news.summary: Oil prices had already fallen quite dramatically on Thursday and Friday in anticipation of a deal. Trump has posted online that the Strait of Hormuz will reopen after the deal is signed this Friday.

breaking_news.headline: How much of an economic boom is the 2026 FIFA World Cup for the U.S. hosting cities?
breaking_news.summary: The FIFA World Cup is thought to bring an economic windfall to the cities and regions where games will be played during four weeks this summer. How true is that?

breaking_news.headline: Visa and OpenAI integrate Visa's secure global payment directly into ChatGPT
breaking_news.summary: Would you hand an AI chatbot your credit card? This week, Visa's deal with ChatGPT maker OpenAI became the latest step in the march toward a future where AI offers to shop on your behalf.

breaking_news.headline: Is it a renter's market? It depends on where you live
breaking_news.summary: About 40% of rentals on Zillow offer move-in deals, like a month of free rent, thanks to a construction boom that created an apartment surplus in some parts of the United States.

breaking_news.headline: Survey confirms the struggle of working parents: 'No way to be two things at once'
breaking_news.summary: A new Pew survey finds many working parents feel they cannot give 100% at either work or home. Benefits like paid sick leave and more affordable childcare could help.

breaking_news.headline: The war with Iran is making oil changes pricier. And a deal won't solve it
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. may be the world's biggest producer of crude oil, but that's not the case for motor oil. The cost of lubricants is soaring, and even a tentative deal to end the war won't solve the problem.

breaking_news.headline: Venezuela signs deal with US energy giant to rebuild power grid
breaking_news.summary: The deal with General Electric is the latest sign of co-operation between US firms and Venezuela's interim government.

breaking_news.headline: France's oldest female detainee, 79, goes on trial for in-law's grisly murder
breaking_news.summary: A dismembered body found in a chain-bound trunk in the Seine in 1995 was only recently connected to the defendant by DNA evidence.

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds of cats stolen for food in Vietnam rescued by police, welfare group says
breaking_news.summary: Police have arrested nine people and rescued more than 400 cats destined for slaughter, with more than 40 reunited with their owners.

breaking_news.headline: German broadcaster removes TV intro after Elon Musk takes legal action
breaking_news.summary: ZDF TV responded to a "cease and desist" letter after the tech trillionaire condemned the broadcaster's "outrageous lies".

breaking_news.headline: Russian artist and Putin critic shot dead in Poland
breaking_news.summary: Robert Kuzovkov, who used the pseudonym Semyon Skrepetsky, has been known for his caricatures of politicians including Vladimir Putin.

breaking_news.headline: UK investigating reports Russian warship fired warning shots near yacht in English Channel
breaking_news.summary: BBC News understands the yacht had drifted towards the Admiral Grigorovich, a Russian frigate which has been operating in the Channel.

breaking_news.headline: Fragile quiet in Lebanon as US-Iran truce leaves unanswered questions
breaking_news.summary: Many Lebanese remain doubtful that the agreement could finally mean the end of the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah.

breaking_news.headline: Tehran selling deal with US as victory – but for Iranians it was necessity
breaking_news.summary: For many Iranians, the question is not whether the deal means victory, but whether it lowers prices and reduces fear of another war.

breaking_news.headline: How could the US-Iran deal affect oil prices and the cost of food?
breaking_news.summary: Experts warn the impact of the war will continue to affect the global economy for months to come.

breaking_news.headline: Why is Thames Water in so much trouble?
breaking_news.summary: Thames Water's lenders have submitted a new rescue plan to save the firm, but how did it end up in this state?

breaking_news.headline: What is Helium-3 and could we get it from the moon?
breaking_news.summary: Helium-3 is expensive and demand is forecast to soar, so some are planning to mine it on the moon.

breaking_news.headline: How the Iran war affects your money and bills
breaking_news.summary: The conflict in the Middle East has increased pressure on the cost of petrol, household energy bills and even food.
